_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 46 (Jacob descends to Egypt; the seventy souls). Saadia-specific: v.4 'יגמצ'ך' = 'shall close [your eyes]' (Saadia preserves the literal idiom for ישית ידו על עיניך — death-bed closing of eyes); v.10 'אבן אלכנעאניה' = 'son of the Canaanite woman' (literal rendering of שאול בן הכנענית); v.34 'אן אלמצריון יכרהון כל ראעי ג'נם' = 'for the Egyptians abhor every shepherd of sheep'.

translations.1: And Israel journeyed, with all that he had, and came to Beer-Sheba; and he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
translations.2: And God said to him, in a vision of the night: 'O Jacob, O Jacob.' He said: 'I am at your service.'
translations.3: He said: 'I am the Power, the God of your father; do not fear to go down to Egypt — for I shall make of you a great nation there.
translations.4: I shall go down with you to Egypt; and I shall surely bring you up again; and Joseph shall close your [eyes].'
translations.5: And Jacob arose from Beer-Sheba; and the children of Israel carried him, and their little ones and their wives, on the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
translations.6: And they took their cattle, and their possessions which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and came to Egypt — Jacob and all his offspring with him:
translations.7: his sons and his sons' sons with him, his daughters and his sons' daughters and all his offspring — he brought with him into Egypt.
translations.8: And these are the names of the children of Israel who came into Egypt — that is Jacob and his sons. The firstborn of Jacob: Reuben.
translations.9: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hetzron, and Karmi.
translations.10: And the sons of Simeon: Yemuel, and Yamin, and Ohad, and Yakhin, and Tzohar; and Saul the son of the Canaanite woman.
translations.11: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translations.12: And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zerah. And Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Perez were Hetzron and Hamul.
translations.13: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puvah, and Yov, and Shimron.
translations.14: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Yahleel.
translations.15: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan-Aram, and Dinah his daughter; the whole of them — thirty-three souls.
translations.16: And the sons of Gad: Tzifyon, and Hagi, and Shuni, and Etzbon, and Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
translations.17: And the sons of Asher: Yimna, and Yishva, and Yishvi, and Beriah; and Serah their sister. And the sons of Beriah: Hever and Malkiel.
translations.18: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; all whom she bore to Jacob: sixteen souls.
translations.19: The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
translations.20: And there were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt, whom Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him: Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.21: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Bekher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
translations.22: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob — all of them: fourteen souls.
translations.23: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.
translations.24: And the sons of Naphtali: Yahtzeel, and Guni, and Yetzer, and Shillem.
translations.25: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter; all that she bore to Jacob: seven souls.
translations.26: All the souls who came with Jacob to Egypt, who came out from their loins — apart from the wives of Jacob's sons — sixty-six souls.
translations.27: And Joseph and his two sons who were born to him in Egypt — two souls. The total of the souls who entered with Jacob into Egypt — seventy.
translations.28: And he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to point him toward the land of al-Sadir (Goshen); and they came to it.
translations.29: And Joseph harnessed his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father in al-Sadir; and when he appeared to him, he fell upon his neck, and wept upon him long.
translations.30: And Israel said to him: 'Let me die now, after I have seen your face — that you are still alive.'
translations.31: Joseph said to his brothers and to the rest of his father's household: 'I shall go up to Pharaoh, and tell him, and say to him: "My brothers and the household of my father, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
translations.32: And the men are shepherds of sheep, for they have been men of cattle; and their sheep and their cattle and all their property they have brought."
translations.33: And it shall be when Pharaoh calls for you, and says: "What is your occupation?"
translations.34: you shall say: "Your servants have been men of cattle from our youth until now — and so were our fathers," — that you may dwell in the land of al-Sadir; for the Egyptians abhor every shepherd of sheep.'
